mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies and a temperature of 33 degrees at Verona City Hall, with an overnight low of 30 degrees and no rain expected. If you look toward the west over Mount Horeb at 7:20 PM, you might spot the International Space Station as it travels toward the northeast near the Madison Home Depot.

The City of Verona has released several notices regarding the November 3, 2026, General Election. Additionally, the Plan Commission is reviewing new development projects, including a site plan and conditional use permit for the Sub-Zero facility in the Liberty Business Park.

There is plenty to do around town. Enjoy live music today at Bailey's Run Vineyard, followed by more music at Lake Lou-ee tomorrow. You can also visit the Dane County Farmers Market at the Capitol tomorrow, or catch the John Denver tribute concert this Saturday at the Verona Area High School Fine Arts Center.
In a report covering last week, officers responded to a call on October 25 involving a driver who was arrested for a first offence O W I after being found stopped in an intersection.
Culver's of Verona is serving up their delicious Raspberry Cheesecake today. The shop is open until 10:30 PM, so there is still plenty of time to stop by for a treat.
